why_chosen: Mid-sized, locally headquartered staffing agency (not a top global name) that actively contacts Singapore candidates and is asked about in public forums as to whether it is legitimate.

identity.summary: Incorporated 22 Feb 1996, live, UEN 199601303W, Ngee Ann City; EA licence 99C4599 (Comprehensive non-FDW); subsidiary of SGX-listed HRnetGroup.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced a company registry aggregator, whose page extracted cleanly with licence details.
identity.what_was_missing: Official MOM EA register could not be checked; licence data is from a third-party aggregator.

business_and_headcount.summary: Contract/temp, permanent and healthcare locum staffing; self-described 400 consultants and 9 offices across Asia Pacific; group 900+ consultants.
business_and_headcount.how_openserp_helped: Extracted company self-description and live job listings.

financial_performance.summary: Only parent HRnetGroup figures (FY2025 earnings about S$52.9m); nothing for Recruit Express alone.
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Search found group results documents; snippets gave headline numbers.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: Subsidiary financials; results PDFs not opened (budget).

layoffs_restructuring.summary: Search returned only generic layoff trackers; nothing naming the company.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: Showed that no company-specific news surfaced.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Any layoff or restructuring record; absence is not proof.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Indeed 3.7/5 (50 reviews), Glassdoor 3.2/5 (393 reviews, snippet); themes: commission pressure, fast pace, lower temp pay, friendly colleagues, mixed management.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Indeed and Jobstreet review pages extracted well; search snippets covered Glassdoor and Reddit.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Glassdoor and Reddit full text were blocked; no turnover data.

pay_and_benefits.summary: Glassdoor snippet about S$4,000/month average for recruitment consultants (estimate); advertised client rates e.g. locum nurse S$32/hr; benefits limited before confirmation per reviews.
pay_and_benefits.how_openserp_helped: Snippets gave salary headline numbers; homepage gave advertised rates.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Full salary pages; benefits detail; candidate take-home after agency margin.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Only snippets on interviews to join the agency; nothing on how candidate placement and fees work.
interview_and_hiring.what_was_missing: Page content and the candidate-side process.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: Licensed; no regulatory action found; complaints are about pressure, commission and one alleged threatening consultant; company warns it never asks for Singpass.
red_flags_and_scams.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced the key Reddit threads and complaint pages; snippets carried the main quotes.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: ComplaintsBoard, Scamadviser and Reddit pages could not be read; no MOM or CASE record check.

recent_news.summary: Only parent-group results announcements (FY2025, 1H2026); no Recruit Express-specific news.

most_useful_sources: search snippets for Glassdoor and Reddit
misleading_or_wrong_results: Glassdoor snippet 'SGD 4,100 per year or SGD 2 per hour' is a clear scraping error
Layoff query returned only unrelated generic trackers

verdict.reasoning: Good for confirming the company is real and licensed and for the broad shape of sentiment. Searches were slow (25 to 37 seconds each) and the review and complaint sites most useful for a legitimacy check were largely unreadable, so the picture of candidate experience rests on snippets and two review pages.
biggest_gaps: Glassdoor, Reddit, ComplaintsBoard and Scamadviser content
Official MOM EA register and complaint record
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Check the MOM EA register for licence 99C4599 and the consultant's registration
Written terms from the consultant: client, salary, contract type, duration
Direct conversations with former placed candidates
